children: Richmond Mutual reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $1.75 million, or diluted earnings per share of $0.11, compared with $2.23 million in the prior quarter and $3.60 million a year earlier. Results included a $6.12 million provision for credit losses and $3.0 million in merger-related expenses, partly offset by a preliminary $1.6 million bargain purchase gain. Net income for the first nine months of 2026 was $6.76 million, or $0.56 per diluted share.
Net interest income was $22.85 million, up from $12.07 million in the second quarter and $11.30 million in the third quarter of 2025.
The provision for credit losses was $6.12 million, compared with $823,000 in the prior quarter and $269,000 a year earlier. Net charge-offs totaled $6.1 million during the quarter.

Noninterest income was $4.56 million, including a preliminary $1.6 million bargain purchase gain. Noninterest expense was $20.01 million and included $3.0 million in nonrecurring merger-related expenses.

Net income was $1.75 million, or $0.11 per diluted share, versus $2.23 million and $0.22 per diluted share in the second quarter of 2026 and $3.60 million and $0.36 per diluted share in the third quarter of 2025.
For the nine months ended September 30, net income was $6.76 million, or $0.56 per diluted share, compared with $8.17 million, or $0.82 per diluted share, in the same period of 2025.
Richmond Mutual completed its merger with Farmers Bancorp on July 1, 2026. The Farmers Bank subsequently merged into First Bank Richmond.
The combined bank operates as First Bank Midwest. The holding company remains headquartered in Richmond, Indiana, and the bank is headquartered in Frankfort, Indiana.
The combined organization had 24 full-service offices at September 30, 2026, serving communities in Indiana and Ohio.
The bank elected to report regulatory capital status under the Community Bank Leverage Ratio framework effective September 30, 2026.
